versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Transit Trip Planner skill.
- Plan transit, walking, or driving trips; compare routes; check live departures or disruptions; and verify Airnode attestations.
- Geocode places and handle ambiguous origins/destinations.
- Integrate with AirnodeHub (BusMaps, Geoapify) APIs, using the narrowest and cost-effective operation.
- Clearly state cost scopes and obtain approval for any potentially paid operations.
- Present actionable routes with full details, including provenance, attributions, and verification status.
